duration.text: The Stomatology at Ningxia Medical University is a 5 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: *1. Photo, without cap, white background without borders, size 100-500 KB, JPG format.*2. Copy of passport, valid for more than 6 months.*3. Non-criminal Record(issued by the local police station)*4. HSK level certificate5. High school graduate certificateGraduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.6. High school academic transcriptHigh school academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.*7. Economic guarantee certificate*8. Physical Examination Record for ForeignerPlease take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature.9. Supporting Documents: Certificate of Good ConductProvided by your current/previous school/company in Chinese/English to improve your success rate.

requirements.text: Applicants for Bachelor degree shall be no more than 25 years old; Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign ordinary passports valid for more than six months (students under the age of 18 must provide their power of attorney for minor custody);Applicants who immigrate from Chinese mainland, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan to foreign countries, shall hold valid foreign passports or international supporting documents for more than 4 years (including), and have a record of actual residence abroad for more than 2 years in the last 4 years (before April 30 of the enrollment year).Love the medical cause, conduct well, be healthy in body and mind, have no criminal record, and consciously abide by the constitution, laws of the people's Republic of China and the university disciplines & rules.Applicants must have HSK-4 certification, students can enter the major after learning one year Chinese Language Program and meeting the relevant language requirements.Applicants for Program of Undergraduate Clinical Medicine Taught in Chinese must have a high school degree or above, or K12 grade (10+2) or equivalent academic ability; English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology courses must pass the graduation examination of the student's country. The minimum scores for applying to undergraduate programs are shown in the above table.
